description: Thesis and mandate: compare one market across Kalshi, Polymarket and Novig. Input market: a topic such as Jaguars Ravens, a Kalshi ticker or a Kalshi or Polymarket market URL. For each outcome, returns each venue’s bid, ask and midpoint where it quotes, the thesis fair value weighted across quoted venues, the midpoint spread between every pair of venues and each venue’s gap to fair value, in points on a $1 payout basis. A venue that does not carry the market, or lists it without a usable quote, is named with the reason. Several matching games return candidates without charge. POST /api/thesis-compare. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/thesis-mandate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/thesis-mandate/.
